description: Change the business's opening hours, timezone, or one-off closed dates ("we're closed Friday the 27th"). Same change as the dashboard's hours page, admin role required. Only the days you pass change; every other day keeps what it had. A day is { open: 'HH:MM', close: 'HH:MM' } in 24-hour time, or { closed: true }. closed_dates adds dates the business is shut; reopen_dates removes them. Call routing that follows business hours uses the new hours from the next call. Returns the saved week as read back.

business_id.description: The business. Required when the account has more than one.

closed_dates.description: Dates the business is closed, e.g. [{ date: "2026-11-27", name: "Thanksgiving" }].

hours.description: Days to change, keyed monday..sunday. Example: { saturday: { open: '09:00', close: '13:00' }, sunday: { closed: true } }.

name: set_business_hours
title: Set Business Hours
